mapper.select: SELECT chat_session_no, anonymous_id, user_no, scenario_no, version_no, current_node_no, state, started_at, last_activity_at, expires_at, ip_hash, user_agent_hash, frst_reg_dt FROM tb_chat_session WHERE chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid
mapper.sql: s.chat_session_no, left(s.chat_session_no::text, 8) AS session_key, s.scenario_no, sc.title AS scenario_title, s.state, s.current_node_no, s.started_at, s.last_activity_at, s.expires_at, COALESCE(count(m.chat_message_no), 0) AS message_count, ( SELECT lm.content FROM tb_chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_no = s.chat_session_no ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.chat_message_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message, ( SELECT lm.content_ciphertext FROM tb_chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_no = s.chat_session_no ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.chat_message_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_ciphertext, ( SELECT lm.content_key_id FROM tb_chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_no = s.chat_session_no ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.chat_message_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_key_id, ( SELECT lm.content_encryption_version FROM tb_chat_message lm WHERE lm.session_no = s.chat_session_no ORDER BY lm.seq DESC, lm.chat_message_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS last_message_encryption_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_chat_session s JOIN tb_scenario sc ON sc.scenario_no = s.scenario_no LEFT JOIN tb_chat_message m ON m.session_no = s.chat_session_no WHERE s.anonymous_id = #{anonymousId}::uuid AND s.frst_reg_dt >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY s.chat_session_no, sc.title ORDER BY s.last_activity_at DESC, s.chat_session_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM tb_chat_session s JOIN tb_scenario sc ON sc.scenario_no = s.scenario_no LEFT JOIN tb_chat_message m ON m.session_no = s.chat_session_no GROUP BY s.chat_session_no, sc.title ORDER BY s.last_activity_at DESC, s.chat_session_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM tb_chat_session s JOIN tb_scenario sc ON sc.scenario_no = s.scenario_no LEFT JOIN tb_chat_message m ON m.session_no = s.chat_session_no WHERE s.chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid GROUP BY s.chat_session_no, sc.title
WITH lock AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('chat_session:' || #{sessionId}::text)) ) SELECT 1 FROM lock
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_chat_session SET current_node_no = #{currentNodeId}, state = #{state}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_activity_at = now() WHERE chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid
UPDATE tb_chat_session SET state = 'EXPIRED', last_activity_at = now() WHERE chat_session_no = #{id}::uuid AND state = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE tb_chat_session SET state = 'EXPIRED', last_activity_at = now() WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at < #{cutoff}
